name: storelink
description: Run your Store.link store from a conversation: orders, products, coupons, pages, design and sales.

interface.shortDescription: Manage orders, products, coupons and your storefront
interface.longDescription: Connect your Store.link account to check sales, find and update orders, add or edit products, create coupons, write store pages and change your storefront design. Every action uses your role in each store, and changes go live immediately.
defaultPrompt: Mark my latest order as shipped
Create a 10% coupon that ends Sunday
